verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's agentic-workflows page lists a first-party Transaction Monitoring agent that auto-remediates level 1 alerts and escalates high-risk or complex cases to human reviewers, so an in-product agent does work transaction alerts. The evidence is a few short marketing lines, and on the Starter Plan the agent configurations are standardized and cannot be customized. missing for 10: evidence the agent prepares review notes or investigation narratives for analysts, detail on how it investigates alerts, technical docs beyond marketing copy, hands-on or independent corroboration.
